Resolves #19577

neo moves its `neo-agent-skills` package pin from 0.1.30 to 0.1.39, the release published after neomjs/neo-agent-skills#167 merged. A seat working in a neo clone then loads #158, #163 and #167 after its next `npm install`, instead of waiting for Monday's Dependabot run. The reusable-workflow refs in `pr-baseline.yml` and `dependabot-automerge.yml` stay as they are, so the CI gates do not change.

Evidence: L1 (lock consistency, materialize and secrets checks run locally) → L1 required for AC-1/AC-2; AC-3 is this PR's own CI run; AC-4 and AC-5 are post-merge. Residual: none.
